Arnoldi-Krylov approximation of exp(t A) v

Source: R/slow_fast.R
expm_krylov.Rd

Approximates the action of the matrix exponential on a vector via projection onto a Krylov subspace built by Arnoldi iteration. Returns exp(t A) v without ever forming exp(t A).

Usage

expm_krylov(A, v, t = 1, m = 30, tol = 1e-10)

Arguments

A

A square numeric matrix.

v

A numeric vector with the same length as the columns of A.

t

Scalar time (default 1).

m

Krylov subspace dimension (default 30).

tol

Tolerance for early termination of the Arnoldi process (default 1e-10).

Value

Numeric vector exp(t A) v.

References

Saad, Y. (1992). Analysis of some Krylov subspace approximations to the matrix exponential operator. SIAM J. Numer. Anal. 29(1), 209-228. doi:10.1137/0729014 .

See also

expm_pade, slow_fast_partition.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
A <- matrix(c(-2, 1, 0, -2), 2, 2)
expm_krylov(A, c(1, 0), t = 1)
} # }
